title: Local AC1024 VIEWPORT layer-override witness census
scope: Check whether existing local AC1024 DWGs and LibreDWG 0.14 outputs provide physical VIEWPORT groups 335, 343, 344 or 91 suitable for a bounded implementation profile.

formatReferences.finding: Autodesk lists VIEWPORT groups 335, 343, 344 and 91 as soft-pointer references for layer viewport-property overrides.
ezdxf documents per-viewport layer overrides as layer-table data and says their DXF structure is undocumented; this does not resolve target roles or native behavior for the four VIEWPORT references.

commands.inspection: Pair ASCII DXF group-code/value lines, count VIEWPORT records, and inspect their groups; inspect direct JSON OBJECTS for entity=VIEWPORT and override-related member names.

limitations: LibreDWG is a peer parser/writer, not a normative producer or native consumer for these fields; its omission cannot establish that source DWGs lack the references.
The direct JSON schema does not expose raw DWG groups and may omit fields its parser does not model; its missing member names are non-evidence of physical absence.
No physical group-335/343/344/91 witness, resolved target-kind proof, coupled dictionary/key/name/body proof, or native viewport-layer behavior was established.
The input DWGs were pre-existing local material and remain outside the repository; generated DXFs and JSON were written under /private/tmp and were not committed.
disposition: No typed mapping or support claim is justified from this census. Obtain a conforming physical source with the reference targets and coupled layer/dictionary records, then prove native behavior; preserve strict refusal until then.
nextAction: Continue independently actionable P4/P5-P8 implementation work. Revisit these four fields only when a physical producer witness supplies exact encodings and target roles.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.
